objections.reason: The residual needs both singleton q values and two successful ordered q values. A categorical FAIL head is mentioned but mixed-success masks, regression masks, rescued branches and ranking/fallback denominators are unspecified. Physical incidence is unknown, not demonstrated.
objections.required_action: Before experiment consent define all reachable singleton/order success masks, categorical heads and branch-specific numerical targets/fallback. Preserve rescued successes or explicitly restrict domain and charge lost opportunity.

objections.reason: For two successes let c=(y_ab+y_ba)/2 and d=(y_ab-y_ba)/2. The ordered squared loss equals 2 times common/contrast squared loss only under correspondingly transformed predictors, scaling, masks, regularizers and optimization. Current raw-label/parameter matching omits these controls. This is an attribution gap, not a universal no-go theorem.
objections.required_action: Add common-mean/contrast without singleton residualization and exactly transformed direct control where feasible; lock losses, normalization, label access, masking, regularization and tuning cost. Identify any useful remaining inductive-bias delta.

objections.reason: The tasklist preamble and experiment-plan explicitly prohibit new experiments now and require signatures before physical execution; therefore no current unauthorized run is established. However EXP-002/003 list grant dependencies while dual consent appears explicitly later, and EXP-009 is after work. The future dependency graph needs an explicit pre-execution gate.
objections.required_action: Separate source-only preparation from execution. Bind exact phase/tasklist, rights/resource/environment/oracle/threshold manifests and dual consent before any baseline, incidence or training run; EXP-009 cannot retroactively authorize execution.
